courses.description: A comprehensive introduction to Python programming language, perfect for beginners and intermediate programmers. This course covers everything from basic syntax to advanced concepts like object-oriented programming. Python's readable syntax and extensive library support make it an ideal first programming language. Students will learn through hands-on exercises, real-world projects, and interactive coding challenges. By the end of this course, you'll be able to create complex applications and understand core programming concepts.

chapters.title: Introduction to Python
chapters.description: Begin your Python journey by understanding what makes Python unique among programming languages. Learn about Python's history, its philosophy of 'readable code', and why it's one of the most popular programming languages today. We'll cover installation procedures for different operating systems, setting up your development environment, and writing your first Python program. You'll also learn about different Python versions and the Python interpreter.
chapters.sampleCode:
print('Hello, World!')
# This is a comment in Python
name = input('What is your name? ')
print(f'Welcome to Python, {name}!')

chapters.title: Variables and Data Types
chapters.description: Explore Python's fundamental data types including integers, floating-point numbers, strings, and booleans. Learn how Python handles variables differently from other languages, with dynamic typing and reference counting. We'll cover type conversion, variable naming conventions, and best practices for variable management. You'll understand how memory management works in Python and how to use the built-in functions to work with different data types.
chapters.sampleCode:
age = 25              # integer
height = 1.75         # float
name = 'John Doe'     # string
is_student = True     # boolean

print(type(age))
print(f'Age in 5 years: {age + 5}')

chapters.title: Control Flow and Decision Making
chapters.description: Master the art of controlling program flow using conditional statements and loops. Learn how to write if-elif-else statements, use comparison and logical operators, and implement various types of loops including for and while loops. We'll also cover loop control statements like break and continue, and how to use the range function effectively. Understanding control flow is crucial for writing programs that can make decisions and repeat actions.

chapters.title: Functions and Modules
chapters.description: Learn how to write reusable code by creating functions and organizing them into modules. Understand function parameters, return values, and scope rules in Python. We'll cover both built-in functions and how to create your own custom functions. You'll learn about default arguments, keyword arguments, variable-length arguments, and docstrings. The module section will teach you how to organize your code into separate files and use Python's import system.
chapters.sampleCode:
def calculate_area(length, width=1):
    """Calculate area of a rectangle."""
    return length * width

# Using the function
print(calculate_area(5, 3))
print(calculate_area(10))  # Using default width

chapters.title: Lists and Tuples
chapters.description: Dive deep into Python's sequence types, focusing on lists and tuples. Learn how to create, modify, and manipulate these fundamental data structures. You'll understand the differences between mutable and immutable sequences, list comprehensions, and common operations like slicing and concatenation. We'll also cover advanced topics like nested lists, tuple packing and unpacking, and how to use these structures effectively in your programs.
chapters.sampleCode:
# List operations
numbers = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
numbers.append(6)
numbers.extend([7, 8])

# List comprehension
squares = [x**2 for x in numbers]

# Tuple packing/unpacking
point = (3, 4)
x, y = point

chapters.title: Dictionaries and Sets
chapters.description: Explore Python's associative array implementation through dictionaries and learn about the unique properties of sets. You'll learn how to create and manipulate dictionaries, handle key-value pairs, and use dictionary comprehensions. The set section will cover mathematical set operations, removing duplicates from sequences, and using sets for membership testing. You'll understand when to use each data structure and their performance characteristics.

chapters.title: Object-Oriented Programming
chapters.description: Understand the principles of object-oriented programming in Python. Learn about classes, objects, inheritance, and polymorphism. You'll discover how to create your own classes, use class and instance methods, and work with class inheritance. We'll cover important concepts like encapsulation, method overriding, and the use of special methods (magic methods) in Python classes. You'll also learn about class decorators and properties.

chapters.title: File Handling and Exception Management
chapters.description: Learn how to work with files and handle errors in Python programs. You'll understand different file modes, reading and writing operations, and file object methods. The exception handling section covers try-except blocks, raising custom exceptions, and cleaning up resources with the 'with' statement. You'll learn best practices for error handling and how to make your programs more robust and reliable.

chapters.title: Working with External Libraries
chapters.description: Explore Python's rich ecosystem of external libraries and packages. Learn how to use pip for package management, virtual environments for project isolation, and common libraries like requests for HTTP, pandas for data analysis, and matplotlib for visualization. You'll understand how to read library documentation, install dependencies, and integrate third-party code into your projects. This chapter also covers best practices for managing project dependencies.
chapters.sampleCode:
import requests
import pandas as pd

# Fetch data from an API
response = requests.get('https://api.example.com/data')
data = response.json()

# Create a DataFrame
df = pd.DataFrame(data)
print(df.head())

chapters.title: Advanced Python Concepts
chapters.description: Delve into advanced Python features including decorators, generators, context managers, and metaclasses. Learn about the inner workings of Python's iteration protocol, how to create custom decorators, and when to use generators for memory-efficient iteration. You'll also understand advanced concepts like closures, the descriptor protocol, and how to use metaclasses to customize class creation. This chapter will help you write more sophisticated and efficient Python code.
chapters.sampleCode:
# Generator function
def fibonacci(n):
    a, b = 0, 1
    for _ in range(n):
        yield a
        a, b = b, a + b

# Decorator
def timer(func):
    def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
        start = time.time()
        result = func(*args, **kwargs)
        print(f'Time taken: {time.time() - start}')
        return result
    return wrapper

courses.description: Master PHP, the widely-used server-side scripting language that powers millions of websites. This comprehensive course covers both basic and advanced PHP concepts, including web development fundamentals, database integration, and modern PHP practices. You'll learn how to build dynamic websites, handle form data, work with databases, and implement secure coding practices. The course emphasizes practical, real-world applications and follows current PHP standards and best practices.

chapters.title: Getting Started with PHP
chapters.description: Begin your PHP journey by understanding its role in web development and server-side programming. Learn about PHP's architecture, how it interacts with web servers, and its integration with HTML. We'll cover PHP installation, configuration of development environments, and basic syntax. You'll understand how PHP scripts are executed and how to set up a local development server for testing your applications.
chapters.sampleCode:
<?php
    echo 'Hello, World!';
    phpinfo();
    $version = PHP_VERSION;
    echo "Running PHP version: $version";
?>

chapters.title: Variables and Data Types in PHP
chapters.description: Explore PHP's variable system and various data types including integers, floats, strings, booleans, arrays, and objects. Learn about variable scope, type casting, and PHP's type system. You'll understand how PHP handles different data types, type juggling, and type comparison. We'll also cover variable variables, constants, and predefined variables in PHP. This foundation is crucial for writing effective PHP code.
chapters.sampleCode:
<?php
    $age = 25;             // Integer
    $price = 19.99;         // Float
    $name = "John";         // String
    $is_active = true;      // Boolean
    define('MAX_USERS', 100); // Constant
    
    var_dump($age, $price, $name, $is_active);
?>

chapters.title: Control Structures and Functions
chapters.description: Master PHP's control structures including if statements, switch cases, loops, and function declarations. Learn how to write clean, reusable functions with proper parameter handling and return values. We'll cover both traditional and alternative syntax for control structures, function variable scope, and passing arguments by reference versus value. Understanding these fundamentals is essential for writing structured PHP applications.
chapters.sampleCode:
<?php
    function calculateDiscount($price, $percentage) {
        if ($percentage > 0 && $percentage <= 100) {
            return $price * (1 - $percentage/100);
        }
        return $price;
    }
    
    $final_price = calculateDiscount(100, 20);
    echo $final_price; // Outputs 80
?>

chapters.title: Arrays and Array Functions
chapters.description: Dive deep into PHP's powerful array system, including indexed arrays, associative arrays, and multidimensional arrays. Learn about array manipulation functions, sorting, filtering, and mapping operations. You'll understand how to use array functions effectively, work with array pointers, and perform common array operations. We'll also cover array merging, splitting, and advanced array functions for data manipulation.
chapters.sampleCode:
<?php
    $fruits = ['apple', 'banana', 'orange'];
    $user = [
        'name' => 'Alice',
        'age' => 25,
        'email' => 'alice@example.com'
    ];
    
    array_push($fruits, 'grape');
    $filtered = array_filter($fruits, fn($fruit) => strlen($fruit) > 5);
?>

chapters.title: Working with Forms and HTTP
chapters.description: Learn how to handle HTML forms in PHP, process user input, and manage HTTP requests and responses. Understand GET and POST methods, form validation, file uploads, and security considerations when handling user data. We'll cover $_GET, $_POST, $_FILES, and $_SESSION superglobals, and learn how to implement proper form validation and sanitization to prevent common security vulnerabilities.
chapters.sampleCode:
<?php
    if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
        $name = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'name', FILTER_SANITIZE_STRING);
        $email = filter_input(INPUT_POST, 'email', FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL);
        
        if ($email === false) {
            echo 'Invalid email address';
        }
    }
?>

chapters.title: Database Integration with MySQL
chapters.description: Master database operations in PHP using MySQL. Learn about database connections, CRUD operations, prepared statements, and result handling. You'll understand how to write secure database queries, handle transactions, and implement error handling. We'll cover both the MySQLi and PDO extensions, teaching you best practices for database integration and how to prevent SQL injection attacks in your applications.
chapters.sampleCode:
<?php
    $pdo = new PDO('mysql:host=localhost;dbname=myapp', 'user', 'password');
    $stmt = $pdo->prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?');
    $stmt->execute([1]);
    $user = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    
    // Insert new record
    $stmt = $pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO users (name, email) VALUES (?, ?)');
    $stmt->execute(['John', 'john@example.com']);
?>

chapters.title: Object-Oriented PHP
chapters.description: Explore object-oriented programming concepts in PHP including classes, objects, inheritance, and interfaces. Learn about visibility modifiers, static methods and properties, abstract classes, and traits. You'll understand how to implement the MVC pattern, use namespaces, and autoload classes. This chapter covers modern OOP practices in PHP and how to structure larger applications using object-oriented principles.
chapters.sampleCode:
<?php
    class User {
        private $name;
        private $email;
        
        public function __construct(string $name, string $email) {
            $this->name = $name;
            $this->email = $email;
        }
        
        public function getEmail(): string {
            return $this->email;
        }
    }
?>

chapters.title: Error Handling and Debugging
chapters.description: Learn professional error handling techniques in PHP including try-catch blocks, custom exceptions, and error logging. Understand how to use debugging tools, configure error reporting, and implement proper error handling in production environments. We'll cover various debugging techniques, how to use xdebug, and best practices for logging and monitoring PHP applications to ensure reliability and maintainability.
chapters.sampleCode:
<?php
    try {
        $file = fopen('nonexistent.txt', 'r');
        if (!$file) {
            throw new Exception('Failed to open file');
        }
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        error_log($e->getMessage());
        echo 'An error occurred: ' . $e->getMessage();
    } finally {
        if (isset($file)) {
            fclose($file);
        }
    }
?>

chapters.title: API Development with PHP
chapters.description: Learn how to build robust RESTful APIs using PHP. Understand HTTP methods, status codes, and API authentication methods including JWT tokens. You'll learn about API versioning, rate limiting, and how to structure API responses. We'll cover best practices for API documentation, handling cross-origin requests (CORS), and implementing API security measures. You'll also learn about API testing and validation of request/response data.
chapters.sampleCode:
<?php
    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    
    $api = new API();
    $data = $api->validateRequest();
    
    switch ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD']) {
        case 'GET':
            $response = $api->handleGet($data);
            break;
        case 'POST':
            $response = $api->handlePost($data);
            break;
        default:
            http_response_code(405);
            $response = ['error' => 'Method not allowed'];
    }
    
    echo json_encode($response);
?>

chapters.title: Modern PHP Features and Best Practices
chapters.description: Explore modern PHP features including arrow functions, null coalescing operators, type declarations, and return type declarations. Learn about PHP 8's features like named arguments, attributes, and the match expression. You'll understand how to use Composer for dependency management, follow PSR standards, and implement modern PHP development workflows. This chapter also covers code quality tools, static analysis, and writing clean, maintainable PHP code.
chapters.sampleCode:
<?php
    declare(strict_types=1);
    
    class Calculator {
        public function add(int|float ...$numbers): float {
            return array_sum($numbers);
        }
    }
    
    #[Route('/api/v1/calculate')]
    public function calculate(float $x, float $y): array {
        $result = $x <=> $y;
        $status = match($result) {
            -1 => 'less',
            0 => 'equal',
            1 => 'greater'
        };
        return ['status' => $status];
    }
?>

chapters.title: Performance Optimization and Caching
chapters.description: Master techniques for optimizing PHP application performance including code optimization, caching strategies, and database query optimization. Learn about different caching mechanisms like Memcached, Redis, and PHP's built-in OPcache. You'll understand how to implement output buffering, use content delivery networks (CDNs), and optimize asset loading. This chapter also covers profiling tools, identifying bottlenecks, and implementing efficient caching strategies.
chapters.sampleCode:
<?php
    // Using Redis for caching
    $redis = new Redis();
    $redis->connect('127.0.0.1', 6379);
    
    $cacheKey = 'user:profile:' . $userId;
    $userProfile = $redis->get($cacheKey);
    
    if ($userProfile === false) {
        $userProfile = $database->fetchUserProfile($userId);
        $redis->setex($cacheKey, 3600, serialize($userProfile));
    } else {
        $userProfile = unserialize($userProfile);
    }
?>

courses.description: A comprehensive course on modern JavaScript programming, covering both frontend and backend development. Learn everything from basic syntax to advanced concepts like asynchronous programming and modern ES6+ features. This course will teach you how to build interactive web applications, work with the DOM, handle events, and use modern JavaScript frameworks. Perfect for beginners and intermediate developers looking to master JavaScript.

chapters.title: JavaScript Fundamentals
chapters.description: Begin your JavaScript journey by understanding the core concepts of the language. Learn about variables, data types, operators, and control structures. You'll understand how JavaScript works in browsers, the concept of the global window object, and how to include JavaScript in web pages. This chapter covers the building blocks needed for any JavaScript developer, including scope, hoisting, and the differences between var, let, and const.

chapters.title: DOM Manipulation and Events
chapters.description: Master the Document Object Model (DOM) and learn how to dynamically modify web pages. Understand event handling, bubbling, and delegation. You'll learn different methods to select and modify elements, create and remove DOM nodes, and handle various types of events. This chapter also covers best practices for DOM manipulation and how to ensure your code is performant when working with the DOM.

chapters.title: Asynchronous Programming
chapters.description: Explore asynchronous programming in JavaScript using callbacks, promises, and async/await syntax. Learn how to handle API calls, manage concurrent operations, and understand the event loop. You'll master error handling in asynchronous code, learn about Promise chaining, and understand how to handle multiple promises simultaneously. This chapter is crucial for modern JavaScript development and working with APIs.

chapters.title: Modern JavaScript Features
chapters.description: Discover ES6+ features that make JavaScript more powerful and expressive. Learn about arrow functions, destructuring, spread/rest operators, classes, and modules. You'll understand template literals, default parameters, and enhanced object literals. This chapter covers how these modern features can make your code more concise and maintainable, while also explaining their practical applications in real-world scenarios.

chapters.title: Working with APIs and AJAX
chapters.description: Learn how to interact with web APIs using various JavaScript methods including XMLHttpRequest, Fetch API, and Axios. Understand how to handle different types of API responses, send various types of requests, and manage API authentication. This chapter covers RESTful API concepts, handling CORS, and best practices for API integration in frontend applications.

chapters.title: Error Handling and Debugging
chapters.description: Master JavaScript error handling techniques and debugging strategies. Learn about different types of errors, how to use try-catch blocks effectively, and custom error handling. You'll understand how to use browser developer tools for debugging, how to set breakpoints, and how to debug asynchronous code. This chapter also covers error logging, source maps, and best practices for error handling in production applications.

chapters.title: Performance Optimization
chapters.description: Learn techniques for optimizing JavaScript applications for better performance. Understand concepts like debouncing, throttling, memoization, and lazy loading. You'll learn how to measure performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement various optimization strategies. This chapter covers memory management, reducing bundle size, and best practices for writing performant JavaScript code.

courses.description: A comprehensive introduction to the Rust programming language, focusing on its unique features of memory safety and zero-cost abstractions. This course covers everything from basic syntax to advanced concepts like ownership, borrowing, and concurrency. Learn how to write safe, concurrent, and efficient systems programming code while understanding Rust's powerful type system and modern programming paradigms.

chapters.title: Rust Fundamentals
chapters.description: Begin your journey into Rust programming by understanding its core concepts and syntax. Learn about variables, basic data types, functions, and control flow. You'll understand Rust's unique features like immutability by default and type inference. This chapter covers the foundation needed to write basic Rust programs while introducing the concept of ownership that makes Rust unique.

chapters.title: Ownership and Borrowing
chapters.description: Master Rust's ownership system, one of its most unique and powerful features. Learn about ownership rules, borrowing, references, and lifetimes. You'll understand how Rust manages memory without a garbage collector while ensuring memory safety at compile time. This chapter is crucial for understanding how to write safe and efficient Rust code.

chapters.title: Structs and Enums
chapters.description: Explore Rust's compound data types through structs and enums. Learn how to define and use structs for creating custom data types, implement methods using impl blocks, and work with enums for representing multiple possible values. You'll understand how Rust's enums are more powerful than traditional C-style enums and how they enable powerful pattern matching.

chapters.title: Error Handling
chapters.description: Learn Rust's robust error handling mechanisms using the Result and Option types. Understand how to handle different types of errors, work with the ? operator, and create custom error types. You'll learn about panic! and when to use it versus Result, as well as how to propagate errors up the call stack. This chapter covers best practices for error handling in Rust applications.

chapters.title: Generic Types and Traits
chapters.description: Explore Rust's powerful abstraction mechanisms through generic types and traits. Learn how to write code that works with multiple types while maintaining type safety at compile time. You'll understand how to define and implement traits, use trait bounds, and work with associated types. This chapter covers how to write flexible and reusable code while maintaining Rust's safety guarantees.

chapters.title: Concurrency and Threading
chapters.description: Master Rust's concurrency features, including threads, message passing, and shared state concurrency. Learn how to create and manage threads, use channels for communication between threads, and safely share data between threads. You'll understand how Rust's ownership system prevents common concurrency bugs while allowing efficient parallel programming.

chapters.title: Advanced Patterns and Features
chapters.description: Explore advanced Rust features including pattern matching, unsafe Rust, advanced traits, and macros. Learn about different pattern matching techniques, when and how to use unsafe code safely, and how to create declarative macros. You'll understand advanced type system features and how to leverage Rust's powerful macro system for metaprogramming.

courses.description: A comprehensive course on modern C++ programming, covering both fundamental concepts and advanced features introduced in C++11 and later standards. Learn about object-oriented programming, memory management, templates, and the Standard Template Library (STL). This course emphasizes modern C++ practices, performance optimization, and writing safe, efficient code while understanding low-level system interactions.

chapters.title: C++ Fundamentals and Basic Syntax
chapters.description: Begin your C++ journey by understanding core language features including variables, data types, control structures, and functions. Learn about C++'s type system, operator overloading, and basic input/output operations. This chapter covers the essential building blocks needed for C++ programming while introducing modern C++ practices and syntax improvements from recent standards.

chapters.title: Object-Oriented Programming in C++
chapters.description: Master object-oriented programming concepts in C++ including classes, inheritance, polymorphism, and encapsulation. Learn about constructors, destructors, virtual functions, and access specifiers. You'll understand how to design class hierarchies, implement abstract classes and interfaces, and use modern C++ features like override and final keywords. This chapter covers best practices for OOP design in C++.

chapters.title: Memory Management and Smart Pointers
chapters.description: Learn about C++'s memory management system, including stack vs heap allocation, pointers, references, and modern smart pointer usage. Understand RAII (Resource Acquisition Is Initialization) principle, memory leaks prevention, and how to use smart pointers like unique_ptr and shared_ptr. This chapter covers best practices for managing memory safely and efficiently in modern C++.

chapters.title: Templates and Generic Programming
chapters.description: Explore C++'s powerful template system for generic programming. Learn about function templates, class templates, template specialization, and variadic templates. You'll understand template metaprogramming concepts, SFINAE (Substitution Failure Is Not An Error), and how to write flexible, type-safe generic code. This chapter also covers template parameter deduction and concepts introduced in modern C++.

chapters.title: Standard Template Library (STL)
chapters.description: Master the C++ Standard Template Library, including containers, iterators, algorithms, and function objects. Learn about different container types (vector, list, map, etc.), iterator categories, and how to use STL algorithms effectively. You'll understand the power of generic programming through STL, lambda expressions, and how to combine different STL components for efficient programming.

chapters.title: Concurrency and Multithreading
chapters.description: Learn about concurrent programming in modern C++ using threads, mutexes, condition variables, and atomic operations. Understand how to write thread-safe code, manage data races, and implement synchronization mechanisms. This chapter covers the C++ memory model, async programming with futures and promises, and best practices for concurrent programming.

chapters.title: Modern C++ Features and Best Practices
chapters.description: Explore modern C++ features introduced in C++11 and later standards, including move semantics, perfect forwarding, structured bindings, and modules. Learn about constexpr, initialized members, uniform initialization, and other modern C++ idioms. This chapter covers how to write more efficient and maintainable code using modern C++ features while following current best practices.
